entries.title: Daniel 8:1
segments: ¶In the third year of the reign of king Belshazzar a vision appeared unto me, [even unto] me Daniel, after that which appeared unto me at the first.

entries.title: Daniel 8:2
segments: And I saw in a vision; and it came to pass, when I saw, that I [was] at Shushan [in] the palace, which [is] in the province of Elam; and I saw in a vision, and I was by the river of Ulai.

entries.title: Daniel 8:3
segments: Then I lifted up mine eyes, and saw, and, behold, there stood before the river a ram which had [two] horns: and the [two] horns [were] high; but one [was] higher than the other, and the higher came up last. {the other: Heb. the second}

entries.title: Daniel 8:4
segments: I saw the ram pushing westward, and northward, and southward; so that no beasts might stand before him, neither [was there any] that could deliver out of his hand; but he did according to his will, and became great.

entries.title: Daniel 8:5
segments: And as I was considering, behold, an he goat came from the west on the face of the whole earth, and touched not the ground: and the goat [had] a notable horn between his eyes. {touched...: or, none touched him in the earth} {a notable...: Heb. a horn of sight}

entries.title: Daniel 8:6
segments: And he came to the ram that had [two] horns, which I had seen standing before the river, and ran unto him in the fury of his power.

entries.title: Daniel 8:7
segments: And I saw him come close unto the ram, and he was moved with choler against him, and smote the ram, and brake his two horns: and there was no power in the ram to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground, and stamped upon him: and there was none that could deliver the ram out of his hand.

entries.title: Daniel 8:8
segments: Therefore the he goat waxed very great: and when he was strong, the great horn was broken; and for it came up four notable ones toward the four winds of heaven.

entries.title: Daniel 8:9
segments: And out of one of them came forth a little horn, which waxed exceeding great, toward the south, and toward the east, and toward the pleasant [land].

entries.title: Daniel 8:10
segments: And it waxed great, [even] to the host of heaven; and it cast down [some] of the host and of the stars to the ground, and stamped upon them. {to the host: or, against the host}

entries.title: Daniel 8:11
segments: Yea, he magnified [himself] even to the prince of the host, and by him the daily [sacrifice] was taken away, and the place of his sanctuary was cast down. {to: or, against} {by him: or, from him}

segments: And an host was given [him] against the daily [sacrifice] by reason of transgression, and it cast down the truth to the ground; and it practised, and prospered. {an host...: or, the host was given over for the transgression against the daily sacrifice}

Palmoni} {of...: or, making desolate}

entries.title: Daniel 8:14
segments: And he said unto me, Unto two thousand and three hundred days; then shall the sanctuary be cleansed. {days: Heb. evening morning} {cleansed: Heb. justified}

entries.title: Daniel 8:15
segments: ¶And it came to pass, when I, [even] I Daniel, had seen the vision, and sought for the meaning, then, behold, there stood before me as the appearance of a man.

words.text: ¶And it came to pass, when I, [even] I Daniel

entries.title: Daniel 8:16
segments: And I heard a man's voice between [the banks of] Ulai, which called, and said, Gabriel, make this [man] to understand the vision.

entries.title: Daniel 8:17
segments: So he came near where I stood: and when he came, I was afraid, and fell upon my face: but he said unto me, Understand, O son of man: for at the time of the end [shall be] the vision.

entries.title: Daniel 8:18
segments: Now as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep on my face toward the ground: but he touched me, and set me upright. {set...: Heb. made me stand upon my standing}

entries.title: Daniel 8:20
segments: The ram which thou sawest having [two] horns [are] the kings of Media and Persia.

entries.title: Daniel 8:21
segments: And the rough goat [is] the king of Grecia: and the great horn that [is] between his eyes [is] the first king.

entries.title: Daniel 8:22
segments: Now that being broken, whereas four stood up for it, four kingdoms shall stand up out of the nation, but not in his power.

entries.title: Daniel 8:23
segments: And in the latter time of their kingdom, when the transgressors are come to the full, a king of fierce countenance, and understanding dark sentences, shall stand up. {are...: Heb. are accomplished}

entries.title: Daniel 8:24
segments: And his power shall be mighty, but not by his own power: and he shall destroy wonderfully, and shall prosper, and practise, and shall destroy the mighty and the holy people. {holy...: Heb. people of the holy ones}

words.text: , but not by his own power

entries.title: Daniel 8:25
segments: And through his policy also he shall cause craft to prosper in his hand; and he shall magnify [himself] in his heart, and by peace shall destroy many: he shall also stand up against the Prince of princes; but he shall be broken without hand. {peace: or, prosperity}

entries.title: Daniel 8:26
segments: And the vision of the evening and the morning which was told [is] true: wherefore shut thou up the vision; for it [shall be] for many days.

entries.title: Daniel 8:27
segments: And I Daniel fainted, and was sick [certain] days; afterward I rose up, and did the king's business; and I was astonished at the vision, but none understood [it].
